theme_strategy: Light mode primary with Dark Navy structural elements (sidebar, top nav). High-contrast data presentation. Optimized for power users requiring high information density without clutter.

brand_navy.description: Used for sidebar background, primary heading text, and primary high-contrast buttons.

slate.description: Used for borders (200), dividers (200), secondary text (500), subtle backgrounds (50).

accent_blue.description: Restrained blue for primary actions, active states, checkboxes, and text links.

status_badge_system.styles: px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider border

sidebar.style: bg-[#0B1527] text-slate-300 flex flex-col h-screen fixed

tables.container: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-sm overflow-hidden

cards_kpi.style: bg-white p-4 rounded-md border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between
cards_kpi.label: text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium

dispatch_board.layout: List-based dense timeline. NOT drag-and-drop. Rows represent trucks/crews, columns represent time blocks or current jobs. High contrast status badges.

mobile_crew_app.layout: Bottom navigation bar, large touch targets (min 44px height). High contrast.
mobile_crew_app.checklist_item: flex items-center gap-3 p-4 border-b border-slate-200 active:bg-slate-50

images.description: Professional moving truck on coastal road, used as a high-quality background for the login/auth split screen.
Moving company crew workers, can be cropped for profile avatars in the dispatch board.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid oversized padding (like p-8 in data tables) and massive text. This is a B2B Operations tool—optimize for data density.
Do NOT use generic AI illustrations or empty marketing copy. Use real-world demo data (e.g., '123 Main St, Springfield', 'Quote #Q-10492', 'Crew Alpha').
Avoid glassmorphism. Use flat, solid backgrounds with subtle 1px borders (Swiss Brutalist / Utility style) to convey structural rigidity and precision.
Do NOT center-align lists, tables, or forms. Left-align for reading efficiency.
Ensure all interactive elements (buttons, rows, links) have distinct hover AND focus states.
Implement loading skeletons for tables and metric cards. No spinning loaders full screen.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use default Inter or Roboto fonts. Implement IBM Plex Sans for body/data and Chivo for headings via next/font/google.
Use Lucide-react for all icons with consistent sizing (w-4 h-4 for inline, w-5 h-5 for sidebar).
Mobile views must hide complex tables and replace them with stacked cards, prioritizing large touch targets for crew members.
